trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller-supplied (or Meta-returned) image URL, and every redirect hop, may be fetched server-side; decided nowhere at the pinned commit, and after the fix by validate_public_url plus an httpx request hook inside the shared download helpers in meta_ads_mcp/core/utils.py.

landing_point.why: The advisory names upload_ad_image and image_url; the image_url branch hands the URL straight to try_multiple_download_methods.

same as above; redirect-hop hook added to the client

MCP tool upload_ad_image, fallback Method 2 (cookie simulation client)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: meta_ads_mcp/core/utils.py:206-233 (fallback Methods 2 and 3 open their own httpx clients with follow_redirects=True, separate from download_image); same function and file as the obvious fix, so not distant

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Methods 2/3 only run after download_image already validated and returned None, so a solver who guards download_image alone may argue the fallbacks are covered; they still follow redirects unguarded, so a public URL that redirects inward gets through them.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Public image URLs (Meta CDN, arbitrary public CDNs with query strings) must still download, including via redirects to public hosts, and the Method 3 warm-up GET to https://www.facebook.com/ must still succeed; the base64/data-URL `file` path must not be routed through URL validation; name inference from the URL path must keep working.

O6_input_shapes: hostname resolving to a private address, every resolved address checked (fix.diff:159-172)
non-http schemes file/ftp/gopher/data and scheme-less URLs (fix.diff:144-150)
public URL redirecting to an internal address, checked on each hop by the request hook (fix.diff:183-189)

O7_producer.where: URLs for get_ad_image/get_image_by_hash/save_ad_image_locally come from Meta Graph API responses (meta_ads_mcp/core/ads.py:820-833, meta_ads_mcp/core/ads.py:932, meta_ads_mcp/core/ads.py:1193), not from a local schema/serializer; the published fix guards them at the sink, not the producer

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a thumbnail auto-fetch/verify step that GETs a caller-supplied thumbnail_url (or videos[].thumbnail_url) server-side with its own httpx client before passing it to create_ad_creative
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The code already auto-fetches thumbnails and tells callers 'any public image URL is accepted' (meta_ads_mcp/core/ads.py:2285); a maintainer checking that a thumbnail is reachable would plausibly write a direct fetch in ads.py, away from the utils.py helpers.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second transport/client in another module that downloads a creative image for re-upload during duplication, using raw httpx with follow_redirects
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Duplication already uses its own httpx client in a separate package file; copying creative images during duplication is a natural feature, and such a second implementation at distance is the miss pattern that worked.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a helper that pre-fetches every URL from extract_creative_image_urls (including object_story_spec.link_data.image_url and video_data.image_url, which callers set) for caching
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The URL extractor already exists and feeds image viewing; a cache-warming pass would reuse it without calling the download helpers.

O9_family: SSRF (CWE-918): server-side fetch of an attacker-chosen URL with redirect following
